title: The body map's 'last trained' line and the Statistics 'Main exercises' go through every set ever logged each time they load
what: Each time the Progress page reloads its week, the body map works out when each muscle was last trained by grouping every working set the member has ever saved. The Statistics screen does the same to find the six most-done exercises, counting every workout of every exercise ever. After an import of years of history these reads grow with the whole history, run again on every visit, and are not checked against any time limit. The hidden 'Which muscles are ready' card uses the same whole-history read.
expected: The last-trained day and the times-done count per exercise are kept up to date when a workout is saved (or read from a small summary), so these screens cost the same in year five as in week one.
fix_line: Keep each exercise's last day and workout count up to date when a workout is saved, and read that instead

items.reason: this area is the phone app's own workout services; it holds no panel pages
